page.overview:
Who is Alice?

Alice (アリス Arisu) is a teenage character from The Rise of Darkrai. She helps Ash Ketchum and his friends get around Alamos Town, since she works as the Alamos Town tour guide. She also plays a song called Oración on a leaf whistle to calm any Pokémon and is also known as a music student.

She used to live with her grandmother, Alicia, before Alicia died and befriended her neighbors, Baron Alberto and Tonio. Alice befriended a Gallade living in Alamos Garden, which she had known since she was little. When she was very young, Tonio and Alice were playing in the garden when she slipped and fell. A Darkrai then intervened and saved her life, but Alice bore no recollection of the events, assuming Tonio saved her. She is Darkrai's best friend.
